normalized.result: Yes, this completes the archive flow I want. I archived **No-knead seeded loaf**, opened the **Archive** list and found it sitting there with all its details intact — title, site, description, the picture, everything. Then one click on **Restore to collection** put it right back in my main list and bumped the count back up. That's exactly what I was after: a way to set things aside without losing anything and pull them back whenever I want, which is different from deleting for good. This part feels right.
